projects.title: Backend CRUD API
projects.summary: A small REST API for managing tasks with persistent storage and API documentation.
projects.details: Task API is a RESTful backend application built with Node.js, Express.js, and PostgreSQL for managing tasks. It supports full CRUD operations through REST API endpoints. The project uses Docker and Docker Compose to run the API and database together. It automatically creates the database table and seeds sample tasks when needed. Swagger UI is included for API documentation, and PostgreSQL data is persisted using a Docker volume.
evidence: API endpoints can be demonstrated locally.
Swagger/OpenAPI documentation is available when configured.

projects.title: Electonic Logging Device Application
projects.summary: ELD Trip Planner is a full-stack application for property-carrying truck drivers that plans trips according to FMCSA Hours-of-Service (HOS) rules.
details: Users enter their current location, pickup location, drop-off location, and used cycle hours. The system generates a driving route, required fuel/break/rest stops, and daily ELD log sheets.

The backend uses a Django REST API with an HOS calculation engine, while the React frontend displays the route, trip statistics, stops, and automatically generated daily log sheets. Routing and geocoding are handled using OSRM and OpenStreetMap Nominatim.
evidence: Frontend and backend can be demonstrated through the project.

projects.title: AI Portfolio Guide
projects.summary: A portfolio-grounded AI agent that helps visitors understand projects, skills, education, achievements, and experience.
projects.details: The agent uses a search_portfolio tool to retrieve relevant information from a portfolio.json knowledge base before generating an answer.
evidence: The portfolio knowledge base is read by the backend at request time.
The Gemini model calls the search_portfolio function before answering.

projects.title: FinSight AI: Agentic System for Automated Financial Close & Compliance
projects.summary: An AI-powered agentic platform for automating financial close and compliance through invoice processing, reconciliation, journal validation, and financial reporting.
projects.details: FinSight AI is a Final Year Project (2025–2026) focused on automating financial close and compliance using an AI-powered agentic system. The platform supports OCR-based invoice processing, reconciliation analysis, journal validation, and automated financial reporting. It is built using a full-stack microservices architecture with React, NestJS, and FastAPI, containerized with Docker and deployed on AWS EC2 using Terraform for infrastructure provisioning. The system also integrates secure authentication, encryption, AI-driven workflows, and observability through Grafana and Prometheus.
evidence: OCR-based invoice processing can be demonstrated through the platform.
Reconciliation analysis and journal validation workflows are supported.
Automated financial reporting is integrated into the system.
The microservices architecture uses React, NestJS, and FastAPI with Docker.
Infrastructure deployment is managed using AWS EC2 and Terraform.
Grafana and Prometheus are integrated for monitoring and observability.
